title: StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometryExistence
statement: For any qcqs morphism f:X→S and geometric point s, the canonical small affine neighbourhood geometry [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry] exists. This asserts only the limit cone, qcqs stages, affine transitions and its prescribed projection equations.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text: Apply the fully proved source-library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.nonempty_strictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry of WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometryExistence. It states exactly this existence for the same StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry structure, whose cone has strictLocalization as vertex. No transport is needed here; consumers that need the cone on the original small colimit model use the smallModelLegs transport API of StrictLocalSmallModel.NeighbourhoodGeometry.

proof_origin.by: T6 reusing the complete official-library proof

mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
